prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 4:5 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in golden sand dunes under a clear sky with a smooth flat sand foreground and a standard-height wooden gate frame standing at her side, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, empty of any people other than the subjects, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as them, NO dark background NO black void, TWO people standing side by side with generous spacing so every figure reads clearly and nobody's arms cross a neighbour, the camera set back so both are visible from head to toe, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, in natural sunlight, sharp focus on every figure, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

LEFT: ONE real adult Hawaiian person with a handsome man's face on a full, curvaceous female body — a man in his early 20s, his face exactly the same tone as his body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, an elegant handsome young male face with a high nose bridge, a defined jaw, straight brows and a strong neck, a very faint trace of stubble, pearly white eyeshadow with a clear gloss lip and soft blush, smooth warm bronze skin, a soft amused smile, pure icy-white hair styled in long locs gathered loosely, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a single long brass chain ending in one large faceted ruby drop, and on the other ear a large gold hoop carrying three heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on gold chains of different lengths (a gold teardrop-shaped sinker, a copper ship's anchor, a silver hammer head), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and two to three gold anklets. Extremely long square nails, chrome finish studded with crystals.

A massive V-shaped torso: enormously broad shoulders with capped, rounded deltoids, a thick heavy chest, a deeply carved six-pack abdomen narrowing to a comparatively small waist, huge thick arms with split biceps and horseshoe triceps, wide flaring lats, and powerful thick quads and diamond calves. His head stays in correct proportion to his broad frame. His arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
